result.keywords: This study examines a fictional method of firing decorative ceramic vessels in salt-sheltered coastal kilns, emphasizing glaze chemistry, low-temperature reduction, and tidal humidity effects on surface texture. The work compares small-batch studio practices across island workshops and documents experimental patterns inspired by botanical forms rather than robotics, agriculture, or computational tracking. Results highlight matte cobalt finishes, ash deposits, and crackle variation across three kiln cycles.
result.title: Ceramic Nightbloom in Coastal Kilns.
